release.body:
## Fix
* eccdd62 fix: check results of path and memory APIs by @Bush2021
* 3c2a9ef fix: patch the about page in zstd-compressed paks by @Bush2021

    > On Chrome 160.0.8184 and later, the About page shows the Chrome++ Next version line again and hides the update error. These Chrome versions compress their built-in pages with zstd instead of gzip, which Chrome++ Next could not read until now.
    >
    > The browser keeps the patched page in `Chrome++_PakCache.bin` in the user data directory, so only the first start after a Chrome or Chrome++ Next update spends time preparing it.
    >
    > `version.dll` now carries a zstd decoder and encoder, which adds about 105-115 KB depending on the architecture.

* fd89177 fix: keep the gzip pak patch inside its slot by @Bush2021

## Maintenance
* df38f84 chore: move clang-tidy checks into .clang-tidy and add clice config by @Bush2021
* d643a8b refactor: avoid string copies flagged by clang-tidy by @Bush2021
* 77502f6 perf: skip the launch thread when no commands are set by @Bush2021
* 12dbf5f perf: skip the pak scan in renderers after the browser misses by @Bush2021
* 26b1341 perf: cache the pak patch result across browser starts by @Bush2021

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Bush2021/chrome_plus/compare/1.20.1...1.20.2
